featured.label: Main project
featured.name: CourtRank
featured.description: A platform for padel clubs with a live web product and an iOS application published on the Apple App Store. The current version runs on a TypeScript full-stack foundation, while I work on migrating the backend to Java to strengthen architecture, domain boundaries, and scalability.
highlights: Current TypeScript backend with REST APIs, relational domain modeling, and a Java migration in progress.
Mobile app built with React Native/Expo and integrated with backend services.
Full product cycle: analysis, system design, implementation, deployment, debugging, and iteration.
